name: Adzviser HubSpot
description:
Connect your HubSpot data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about contacts, leads, and deals. Compare companies, dig into how your pipeline is moving, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking this week's pipeline or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser HubSpot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser HubSpot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://hubspot.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser HubSpot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser HubSpot provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_hubspot, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser HubSpot?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser HubSpot in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser HubSpot MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser HubSpot requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser HubSpot is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
